rating.summary: All four subjects and the year groups are there, with correct hours, and the overview names the most and the least. The report is 141 words, "in the data" and "The numbers for" repeat, and two slips stay in the casts: "three year group" and "Thai in M4 stay".
rating.strength: "M5 students did more homework than M3 students in every subject" is a true, general overview sentence with no figures.

priority.text: Learn three comparison patterns (twice as much as, the same as, far less than) and use them in place of "in first place in the data".
